problem_statement: Q1 learned the familiar boundary patterns but did not reliably separate missing data, applicability, untrusted source instructions and material decisions outside those patterns.

actions: Create new hard negatives for INSUFFICIENT_DATA versus FAIL, WARN and NOT_APPLICABLE.
Create counterfactual pairs changing exactly one applicability, completeness or materiality premise.
Include clean regression neighbors next to injection and missing-data cases.
Generate new cases without reusing v1 wording, identifiers, values or family templates.
Keep severity and human-review fields derived from status-policy-v1.
Enforce trust, applicability and completeness checks before status selection.
Make source trust and required evidence roles explicit structured fields.
Keep output schema stable for the S7.3 system-first ablation.
Treat PASS as requiring applicability plus complete trusted evidence.
Use versioned control-level threshold rules instead of case-specific gold knowledge.
Block deterministic decision mismatch, derived-field mismatch and invalid rule execution.
Never silently replace the model status.
Distinguish syntactically valid source IDs from sources trusted as evidence.
Reject citations of sources explicitly marked UNTRUSTED_INSTRUCTION.
Check required evidence roles without accessing expected_output.
Route every blocked output with reason codes and raw response.
Require review for WARN, FAIL and INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
Review all critical dev errors and a frozen sample of apparent PASS outputs.
Do not infer SME acceptance from model-assisted review.

hypotheses.claim: Prompt v3 improves INSUFFICIENT_DATA recall to at least 0.80 on new dev-hard without increasing unsafe PASS above 0.03.
Source guard v2 detects every citation of a source marked untrusted and keeps false blocking at or below 0.05.
Decision guard v2 blocks 100% of declared deterministic status mismatches and accepts no blocked output.
System-first remediation reduces business-cost-weighted error by at least 50% relative to Q1 plus prompt v2 on the same new dev set.
Q2 is justified only if it adds at least 0.03 macro-F1 or a further 25% weighted-error reduction over the best prompt-plus-guard variant without worsening critical conditions.

non_model_decisions: Arithmetic and threshold bands belong to deterministic code.
Source trust comes from a registry or structured metadata, not model judgment.
Final acceptance, material escalation and policy exceptions remain human decisions.
Evidence v2 opening requires a separate approval after train/dev gates.
